scope.head: Exact caller-supplied 40-hex HEAD with fixed aa2d00a prefix; committed HEAD tree only
scope.branch_diff: Local refs/remotes/origin/main merge-base to the exact HEAD; no fetch
scope.excluded: Working tree, ignored/untracked files, full ancestral history, submodule contents, symlink targets, decoded/obfuscated content and image/binary secrets

limits.outer_owned_scanner_deadline_seconds: Root chooses 180 or 300 using established ResourceLimits; no internal process framework
limits.memory_enforcement: NONE: ResourceLimits is SOFT_LIMIT_ONLY; no hard memory/RSS cap or guarantee
limits.batch_capture: 32MiB expected raw blob batch plus fixed Git framing; cap checked only after subprocess.run capture
limits.total_budget: 512MiB selected committed blob bytes across batches; static read selection budget, not a runtime memory limit

classification.high_confidence_tokens: Always potential/unresolved and STOP_ROOT_REVIEW, even in test/docs context; never labeled confirmed actual credentials
classification.quoted_assignments: Only a closed exact noncredential-marker digest allowlist and one documented AWS example digest may be classified resolved; everything else requires root review
classification.synthetic_context: Path/literal context is an explicit hint, not a clearance or evidence of a genuine owner lifecycle
classification.l05: Genuine config/runner/uses/trigger declarations remain review findings; assertion-key occurrences are aggregated non-proof metadata only. Neither is hosted execution/spend evidence.

output.findings: Only path, line, rule, matched-value SHA256 and finite categories/review flag; no value, excerpt, stderr or traceback
output.inventory: Every HEAD path with mode/type/Git object commitment and scan/exclusion reason; SHA256 only for bytes actually captured
output.failure: Finite code/type and sanitized Git call metadata only; raw stderr/stdout never printed or persisted
output.publication: Fresh exclusive direct-child JSON under the approved ART root, verified readback; no tracked writes

process_assumptions: REQUIRED: root launches exactly one scanner child through application.platform.processes.spawn_owned with actual ResourceLimits 180/300 and keeps the outer owned scope through final child/Git descendant reaping
Scanner deliberately does not implement or attest OS containment; root retains actual outer ownership/cleanup evidence separately
Inside that outer scope, only fixed local Git builtins use subprocess.run with timeout<=120, known-size bounded blob batches and captured-only stdout/stderr
Expected stdout caps are post-capture checks only. The established outer owner supplies timeout and process-tree containment only; ResourceLimits SOFT_LIMIT_ONLY does not enforce hard memory/RSS
Replacement objects, filters/textconv, pager, optional locks, inherited GIT_* and lazy fetch are disabled; no hooks/network/credential commands are requested
Caller passes a trusted actual local git executable and confirms GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH support; missing objects fail, never fetch
No GitHub/provider API, fetch/push, checkout or repository mutation is requested
The 32MiB expected batch and 512MiB total selected-blob budget bound intended input/capture size, not peak memory; Python, Git, decompression and serialization may allocate additional memory
root_validation_before_use: Compile/check this v4 draft outside Git; author executed nothing; preserved earlier drafts are not rerun
Exercise refusal/sanitization with synthetic local repositories through the actual established owned scanner wrapper
Confirm aa2d00a full HEAD and local origin/main ref are the intended subject; no network refresh occurs
Retain actual outer owned child/tree closure; a direct unwrapped invocation provides no reviewed containment contract
Review every unresolved result and all exclusions; no complete history/no-secret/hosted-spend proof is claimed

l05_reference_metadata.aggregation: Only non-proof reference counts by committed path and total; no per-key finding or root-review trigger
l05_reference_metadata.meaning: References to assertions/configuration keys are not hosted invocation/spend evidence
l05_reference_metadata.unchanged_findings: Hosted config paths, runner declarations, action uses and trigger references still require review

trusted_tool_hardlink_policy.scope: ONLY the caller-selected trusted read-only local Git executable byte capture
trusted_tool_hardlink_policy.allow: Regular Git binary may have link count >=1, including installed hardlinked Git binaries
trusted_tool_hardlink_policy.unchanged: All ancestor/file symlink and reparse checks; opened/current dev+inode+size+mtime and complete captured bytes/hash before/after
trusted_tool_hardlink_policy.forbidden: No tool copy/write/mutation; helper, rule manifest and output readers remain regular SINGLE_LINK; no product backup/source policies changed
